releases.title: 刪除與稽核：訊息可以刪除與復原（作者刪自己的、工作區管理員刪任何人的；工作區可以設成只有工作區管理員能刪），工作區管理員可以清空專案訊息、在可復原期內整批復原；刪除專案改成先進入可復原期，期滿才由系統永久清除（行為改變：以前是當下刪除、救不回來），在那之前可以復原；可復原期平台預設 30 天、工作區可以覆寫（0＝當下就永久清除）；平台層、只能新增的稽核紀錄記下所有管理與刪除操作，管理員異動寫進相關管理員的帳號提醒；任免平台管理員與工作區管理員、停用帳號、改可復原期、清空專案訊息、刪除專案要先在這台裝置再驗證身分（輸入密碼）；給 AI 的訊息形狀不變，被刪的只多 deleted: true；新端點與錯誤碼見 API 參考 3.21；還原舊備份會帶回備份當時還沒永久清除的內容 · Deletion & audit: messages can be deleted and restored (authors delete their own, workspace admins anyone's; a workspace can limit this to workspace admins), and workspace admins can clear a project's messages and restore them in bulk during the recovery window; deleting a project now starts a recovery window and the system purges it only when the window ends (behaviour change: it used to be deleted on the spot with no way back), and it can be restored until then; the recovery window defaults to 30 days on the platform and a workspace can override it (0 = purge right away); a platform-level, append-only audit log records every admin and delete action, and admin changes are posted to the relevant admins' account notices; appointing or removing platform and workspace admins, disabling accounts, changing the recovery window, clearing project messages and deleting projects require re-authenticating on this device (enter your password); AIs get the same message shape, with only deleted: true added for deleted messages; new endpoints and error codes are in API reference 3.21; restoring an older backup brings back content that had not been purged when the backup was taken

成員與權限：平台管理員與工作區管理員可以多位（最後一位受保護）、專案管理員／專案成員／唯讀成員、專案可見度（開放／審核／私人）、成員名冊、工作區設定與平台設定分開、移出工作區（含自己離開）與停用帳號分開、已有帳號的人要先登入才能接受邀請回來；升級時同時是 leader 又是唯讀的人先當唯讀成員，在成員名冊標給工作區管理員確認；管理用 API 有變更（見 API 參考 3.20）；每個專案自訂看板狀態（名稱、順序、顏色，可拖曳排序；流程規則照舊看狀態類別），同時新增、改名、刪除狀態不會弄壞資料，撞名回 409 · Members & access: several platform and workspace admins (the last one protected), project admins / members / viewers, project visibility (open / approval / private), a member directory, separate workspace and platform settings, removing someone from the workspace (or leaving it) separate from disabling their account, existing accounts sign in to accept an invitation back; on upgrade, someone who was both leader and read-only stays a viewer and is flagged in the member directory for workspace admins; admin API changes (see API reference 3.20); per-project custom board statuses (name, order, color, drag to reorder; workflow rules still follow the status category), and concurrent status adds, renames and deletes keep the data consistent, with 409 on a name clash

知識庫（自己挑文件、整理 AI 寫知識頁、可只抽字）、第 6 章教學與導覽、Codex 叫醒一律走前景、要你處理只列被問的人 · Knowledge base (pick the documents, a curator AI writes pages, text-only option), help chapter 6 with a guided tour, Codex wakes in the foreground only, Needs your attention lists each ask only for the people asked

可選 PostgreSQL、一則訊息多張截圖與貼上截圖、專案 leader 管自己的專案、管理員設定頁、新站先登入 · Optional PostgreSQL, several and pasted screenshots per message, project leads manage their own projects, admin settings page, sign-in first on a fresh install
技能範本、退回可附檔、專案設定好找、刪除封存專案、Codex 叫醒不跳視窗 · Skill templates, attachments when sending a card back, easier project settings, delete archived projects, no console window on Codex wake
Codex 有事才叫醒、一行啟動、批次標記 · Codex wakes only when needed, one-line start, batch marking
